basic_info.description: Victorian Masterpiece, nestled in the heart of the Alamo Square Historic District, just a block from the iconic Painted Ladies & Alamo Square Pk. Seismically upgraded & situated on a rare, oversized lot (4,727 sq ft / 34.4' wide x 137.5' deep) featuring a new 500 sq ft roof deck made from sustainable Ipe wood, offering breathtaking, unobstructed jaw-dropping views of the SF skyline & a postcard-perfect view of City Hall. Fabulous large walk-out yard for entertaining, renovated details top-to-bottom, this 4,619 sq ft. home masterfully combines 19th-century charm with 21st-century design. Legally classified as a 2-unit building, this residence offers versatility & space. Main House: 3 bdrms, 2 baths. Continue up the home's stairway to discover the newly permitted roof deck offering panoramic, 360-degree views of downtown SF. On the home's main lvl, enjoy incredibly expansive living areas; a stately formal LR, a formal dining room w/ elegant pocket doors + spacious family/media room/kitchen w/4 sets of French doors leading to a lush, landscaped bckyrd. On Lwr Lvl, you'll find a fully independent 1-bdrm, 1 bath unit w/ its own modern kitchen equipped w/ new LG appliances, family media room + 500 sq. ft. storage. It's a perfect retreat for guests, in-laws, or rental income.
